en_before: In streetwear, cargos work as a foundation for tees, hoodies, jackets and sneakers. In Y2K, they're often lower-rise and wider, paired with baby tees and shoulder bags. Punk and Grunge combine them with graphic tees, hardware belts and boots. Dark Feminine outfits can contrast black cargos with corsets, sheer tops or fitted pieces.
